decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the weakness is not material to the named launch use case, the case for compliance improves substantially.

evidence_requests: Provide the underlying evidence showing whether the small-business onboarding weakness is formally assessed as material or not material for the named launch use case.

unsupported_claims: Any implicit claim that the residual weakness is already adequately covered by an approved mitigation.
